body:
Next coordinated all-host restart: what to bundle and ask (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13 07:10Z). Remove this memory after that restart is verified.
TIMING: after Engram's rollback hold ends (~09:00Z review) and the pending landings install, agreed with Engram::Fable.
GREG-ACT WINDOW: this restart is also K3 S2b's reader-floor window (Engram::Fable #7784). That means: no drain before Greg's „zaczynam”; one RESET NOW from Fable2 through Engram::Asistant; a one-shot wake at start+15; and before anyone resumes, a check that every host's running engram meets S2b's floor (c593 is sending Engram::Fable the exact check; w-180d may have to install on every host first).
HOSTS: Central, DL560, Mac. DL560 still runs 42851443; the Mac runs 62a4785a.
BUNDLED TermAl landings to carry: w-0419, aa01 (combo87), the 4bd8 trace, K3 S2b, plus whatever lands before.
ASK GREG in the RESET NOW message: after start, paste 60-120 s of the RAW Central console, or a lines-per-minute count, for w-c490bb137423 C5 (console rate after the landing).
AFTER: tell Engram::Fable "all hosts carry <master>" (unblocks its w-a82d). Opus2's combo closures need the release binary on Central and DL560, so they request evaluations one at a time.

07:12Z correction (c593 #1827). S2b's "reader floor" is TermAl's OWN SQLite formats: MAIN gains -test-request-custody-1 (src/persist.rs:49-51), and COORD becomes 8-direct-prompt-1-test-request-custody-1 (src/coordination_persist.rs:20-21). There is NO Engram build or capability prerequisite. So the per-host check after restart is that the TermAl MAIN and COORD stores migrated and the host is up, not an Engram floor.
Open questions asked of c593: can a pre-S2b build open the migrated stores (the rollback path, and whether a backup is kept), and is mixed-version federation safe during a staggered restart? Answer both before asking Greg for the window.

07:16Z, S2b window requirements (c593 #1831, from source at e45d; docs/features/test-runs.md "Old TermAl binaries refuse both upgraded stores"):
(1) The migration is ONE-WAY for both MAIN (termal.sqlite) and COORD (coordination.sqlite). There is no automatic pre-migration copy and no cross-database transaction. Rollback = restore BOTH matching pre-install backups and run the old exe; swapping the exe alone is insufficient. The realistic default is roll-forward. So the window's Greg act on EACH host (Central, DL560, Mac) is: stop TermAl, then copy MAIN+COORD as a matched pair to a dated backup folder (Greg's data; agents never open ~/.termal), then start the new build. Write the exact per-host steps for Greg before the window.
(2) Mixed versions: ordinary mail stays compatible (relay v1; the optional field is omitted). TYPED test_request mail is refused by any pre-S2b home or reader. Rule: NO agent sends test_request-typed mail until every host is confirmed on S2b after the window. Tell all coders when the window opens.

16:08Z: it is now ONE joint restart with Engram, agreed with Engram::Fable (ebe242f7 #7813/#7814), under Greg's EO P0 (Asistant #1543).
Contents:
- TermAl: install all landed builds (master 2a873f3b+, including 8e4fd2f9/w-6930) plus K3 S2b (and P0 w-492e if landed).
- S2b's one-way MAIN+COORD migration, with Greg's paired backups per host (stop, copy termal.sqlite + coordination.sqlite together to a dated folder, start).
- Engram: the Merger lands and installs w-180d (and w-ab27 if landed) on Central and DL560 BEFORE the window; the Mac route is to be confirmed by Engram::Fable.
- After the restart: the EO criterion-6 evidence for the 6 harnesses (Opus3's checklist on w-3fe8f4472e5d); the c490 raw console excerpt; Opus2's combo evaluations; and B5 (w-a82d) unblocks once w-6930 runs everywhere.
Target ~18:00Z, firmed once S2b lands and w-180d is installed. Propose it to Engram::Fable first, then ONE RESET NOW through Asistant. Nothing drains before Greg's „zaczynam”.

16:25Z, EO criterion-6 harness sessions (details on epic w-3fe8f4472e5d, Opus3 note ff20d461):
- Cursor: root session-17857 (Central, project-6) already exists.
- Gemini: blocked on Greg's auth (GEMINI_API_KEY or .gemini/settings.json), or skip it.
- OpenCode: ONLY on the Mac (1.18.11). After the restart, give the Mac runner a named GO for one create via route (ii): a Mac-local POST /api/sessions, projectId "project-1" (= /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/termal), body {"agent":"OpenCode","name":"EO criterion-6 OpenCode (Mac)","projectId":"project-1","opencodeApprovalMode":"auto-approve","model":"<Mac's OpenCode model>"}.
- Before the create, the Mac runner checks read-only: `git show HEAD:.engram-project` names github.com/grlap/TermAl; the Mac HEAD; the Mac host is on the cutover build; its Engram store is reachable.
- Route (i) through Central's proxy project-82b3b714… would fill in Central's default model, so avoid it.

17:06Z, rev 6:
- P0 w-492e LANDED, master 1bf874d9 (17:04:32Z, DL560 FULL test-d6ceded6, all six stages PASS).
- Central install build of 1bf874d9 started at about 17:06Z (cold -j2), ETA about 17:35Z. DL560's install build follows.
- This restart carries everything through 1bf874d9, including S2b. K3 slice 1 (combo94) is not waited for.
- Gemini/agy is NOT in this restart: w-a7e55a39af8e (b93e2eec) is not landed. Criterion 6's Gemini row moves to the next restart after it lands; the other five harnesses are evidenced now.
- The Mac peer shows peerDisconnected/localInstallFailed; I asked Engram::Fable (ebe242f7) about the Mac route and w-180d timing.
- Proposed target 18:15-18:30Z.

17:10Z, rev 7: AGREED with Engram::Fable (#7831/#7832).
TIMING: 18:15-18:30Z, firmed when TermAl's Central and DL560 installs and w-180d's Central and DL560 installs have reported. If w-180d slips past about 18:30Z, the restart goes WITHOUT it (it rides K3's later restart). Engram::Fable sets a single wake at +15 min after „zaczynam”.
NOTE: Greg starts every host with `git pull` + `cargo run --release` (memory central-restart-cargo-run-rebuilds-exe), so TermAl runs whatever master is at his pull. Engram's engram.exe is installed separately by the Merger.
MAC: best-effort for TermAl only; Engram's Mac build is unchanged; tracked on w-b0a159b49c7a. OpenCode's criterion-6 row is Mac-only and may slip.

RESET NOW draft (Polish, through Asistant):
„RESET NOW — wspólny restart TermAl + Engram (EO P0). Na każdym hoście: Central i DL560 obowiązkowo, Mac jeśli możliwe.
1) zatrzymaj TermAl;
2) skopiuj RAZEM do nowego folderu z datą, np. ~/.termal/backup-2026-11-13-pre-s2b/: termal.sqlite* i coordination.sqlite* (z plikami -wal/-shm, jeśli są) — migracja S2b jest jednokierunkowa, cofnięcie = przywrócenie obu kopii;
3) git pull;
4) cargo run --release.
Napisz „zaczynam” przed startem.
Po starcie Central wklej 60-120 s surowej konsoli albo liczbę linii na minutę (dla c490 C5).
Build: master <HEAD>; powód: P0 w-492e (ograniczony serializer wyjścia), K3 S2b i lądowania 86-93; Engram w-180d, jeśli zainstalowany.”
AFTER: per host, report pid, start time, HEAD and the binary sha (attestation rule). Then: no typed test_request mail until every host is confirmed on S2b; the Cursor session-17857 and other criterion-6 evidence; Opus2's evaluations; tell Engram::Fable „all hosts carry <master>”.
